messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> sev2: elevated 5xx across generation API (us-west1). Incident INC-2026-031. Affected routes: /v1/generate streaming and sync. Error rate ~48% over 5m. Pager -> @maya. Logs & traces: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-031

maya: on it. ACKing. I can see elevated 500s from model shard pool A. digging into recent deploys and memory pressure.

maya: quick triage - no deploys in last hour. Heap/allocs on nodes g4dn-8x are spiking, OOM-ish patterns in logs. Reproducing locally with a small batch: consistent 500s when seq_len > 1024.

anna: @maya grabbing the pool scaling dashboard. If it's a KV cache blow-up we can failover to smaller batch size and route to gen-v2 fallback. Preparing canary.

josh: tagging product for customer impact assessment. Which customers currently pinned to us-west1 dedicated?

elaine: @josh listing: AcmeAnalytics (dedicated), Matchly (hosted but region pinned), BetaLabs (hosted). We should assume partial degradation for sync text generation; embeddings unaffected.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) scale down batch_size to 1 for streaming path; 2) spin up replacement nodes from spare pool and drain problematic g4dn-8x nodes; 3) temporary route -> gen-v2-quant fallback for large seqs. Implementing now.

anna: runbook step executed: scaled down batching and added failover route. Patch command I ran: ```redwoodctl route update --service gen --fallback gen-v2-quant --threshold 0.2``` logs show error rate dropping to ~18% after routing change.

incident-bot: Update: automated reroute triggered by policy. Post-change error rate: 17% (5m). Service latency slightly higher for fallback (~20-40ms). Noted for status page.

ryan: drafting initial status copy. Proposed text:
[Initial] We are currently investigating elevated 500 errors affecting the Generation API in us-west1. Some requests may experience failures or higher latency. Our engineers are applying routing mitigations to reduce customer impact. We will post updates as we have them.

liz: quick legal check: avoid saying "root cause" or "data loss". Add note for customers on dedicated plans to contact their CSM for priority follow-up. Also remove exact internal node types from external copy.

ryan: updated draft per @liz: 
[Initial] We are investigating increased error rates for the Generation API in the US West region. Some requests may fail or see increased latency. Our engineering team has applied routing mitigations to reduce impact; we will provide another update within 30 minutes. If you are on a Dedicated plan, please contact your CSM for direct assistance.

elaine: add note for hosted customers who pinned region: "you may see requests routed to alternate region temporarily". Important for latency expectations.

ryan: added that line. New draft ready for publish: https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/INC-2026-031

maya: operational note: current impact is partial; token generation continues for most small requests. We're continuing drain and node replacement. ETA for return to baseline ~25-40m depending on node warmup.

anna: can someone run the publish? I'm on the fix path.

ops-bot: reminder checklist before publish: [x] Initial draft approved by eng [x] Legal reviewed [x] CSM notified [ ] Post at 10:42 UTC? Use CLI: `statusctl post --incident INC-2026-031 --body-file ./draft.txt`

josh: I'll publish. Posting now.

ops-bot: Status page: Posted initial update at 2026-03-15T10:22:40Z. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-2026-031/updates/1

ryan: tweeted short customer-facing note and updated support templates. Copy: "We are investigating elevated generation errors in US West. Mitigations are in place; more updates shortly."

maya: monitoring -- error rate dropped to 6% after additional nodes came up and cache warmed. Still seeing rare 500s for very long sequences.

anna: recommend follow-up update in 20m with status and next steps. If errors stay <10% we can mark as "degraded" not "partial outage".

josh: agreed. Preparing follow-up with metrics.

ops-bot: Follow-up update posted at 2026-03-15T10:42:00Z. Summary: mitigation successful, error rate reduced to ~6%, latency increased for fallback traffic. We will continue to monitor and plan a full revert to normal routing once error rate stable <1% for 15m.

maya: at 10:50 UTC error rate stabilized to 0.8%. Reverting fallback and bringing batch sizes back to normal.

ops-bot: Final update (resolved) posted at 2026-03-15T11:00:00Z. Incident marked RESOLVED. External resolved copy: "The Generation API incident affecting US West has been resolved. A routing mitigation reduced errors while we replaced affected capacity; normal service has been restored. We will follow up with a post-incident report."

ryan: notifying customers and closing support threads. Postmortem: assign to SRE with timeline and RCA; draft due EOD tomorrow.

maya: filing incident ticket INC-2026-031 for postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
